properties.name: name
properties.description: Required identifier for the object. Pass it as the name argument to altdss.Line.new or after Line. in the DSS New command.

properties.name: bus1
properties.description: Name of bus for terminal 1. Node order definitions optional.

properties.name: bus2
properties.description: Name of bus for terminal 2.

properties.name: linecode
properties.description: Reference to an existing LineCode. The LineCode specification set also lists Length. A newly constructed Line already contains a default sequence impedance.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Physical line length in the selected Units. The constructor uses Length=1.0 and Units=None. The default sequence data represents a 1,000 ft line, and an explicit Units value sets the unit used for the modeled length.

properties.name: phases
properties.description: No. of phases. Default = 3. A line has the same number of conductors per terminal as it has phases. Neutrals are not explicitly modeled unless declared as a 'phase', and the impedance matrices must be augmented accordingly.

properties.name: r1
properties.description: Positive-sequence resistance, ohms per unit length. Setting any of R1, R0, X1, X0, C1, C0 forces the program to use the symmetrical component line definition. Default (default Line object): 0.058 ohms per 1000 ft (EPRI Line element page; engine sets R1 := 0.0580).

properties.name: x1
properties.description: Positive-sequence reactance, ohms per unit length. Default (default Line object): 0.1206 ohms per 1000 ft (EPRI Line element page; engine sets X1 := 0.1206).

properties.name: r0
properties.description: Zero-sequence resistance, ohms per unit length. Default (default Line object): 0.1784 ohms per 1000 ft (EPRI Line element page; engine sets R0 := 0.1784).

properties.name: x0
properties.description: Zero-sequence reactance, ohms per unit length. Default (default Line object): 0.4047 ohms per 1000 ft (EPRI Line element page; engine sets X0 := 0.4047).

properties.name: c1
properties.description: Positive-sequence capacitance in nanofarads per unit length. The default is 3.4 nF per 1,000 ft before unit conversion. The engine stores the constructor value in farads and the public property scales it to nanofarads.

properties.name: c0
properties.description: Zero-sequence capacitance in nanofarads per unit length. The default is 1.6 nF per 1,000 ft before unit conversion. The engine stores the constructor value in farads and the public property scales it to nanofarads.

properties.name: b1
properties.description: Alternate way to enter C1, microS per unit length.

properties.name: b0
properties.description: Alternate way to enter C0, microS per unit length.

properties.name: normamps
properties.description: Normal ampacity, amps. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 400.0.

properties.name: emergamps
properties.description: Emergency ampacity, amps. Usually the one-hour rating. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 600.0.

properties.name: faultrate
properties.description: Number of faults per year per unit length. This is the default for this general line construction. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 0.1.

properties.name: pctperm
properties.description: Percent of the faults that become permanent (requiring a line crew to repair and a sustained interruption). Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 20.0.

properties.name: repair
properties.description: Hours to repair. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 3.0 (HrsToRepair := 3.0 in the Line constructor).

properties.name: basefreq
properties.description: Base frequency in Hz for the impedance values. The Line constructor inherits its base frequency rather than assigning a fixed value here. A LineCode replaces it with that LineCode's base frequency.

properties.name: rmatrix
properties.description: Series resistance matrix, ohms per unit length. See Command Language for syntax ('|' separates rows; extraneous numbers on each row are ignored). Lower triangle form is acceptable. Using any of Rmatrix, Xmatrix, Cmatrix forces the program to use the matrix values for line impedance definition. Alternative direct impedance source (no linecode needed).

properties.name: xmatrix
properties.description: Series reactance matrix, ohms per unit length.

properties.name: cmatrix
properties.description: Shunt nodal capacitance matrix, nanofarads per unit length.

properties.name: switch
properties.description: Marks the Line as a switch. In DSS C-API 0.14.5, setting Switch=True marks the symmetrical-component definition as changed, clears previous line code, geometry, and spacing specifications, sets R1, X1, R0, and X0 to 1.0, sets C1/C0 to 1.1/1.0 nF, sets Length to 0.001, and resets length-unit selection. Apply intended overrides after setting Switch.

properties.name: rg
properties.description: Carson earth return resistance per unit length used to compute impedance values at base frequency. For making better frequency adjustments. Does not apply to impedances defined by Geometry. Default values are same as for the default LineCode object: 0.01805 ohms per 1000 ft at 60 Hz for Rho=100 (EPRI Line element page). Set both Rg and Xg = 0 to disable earth return frequency adjustment.

properties.name: xg
properties.description: Carson earth return reactance per unit length used to compute impedance values at base frequency. For making better frequency adjustments. Does not apply to impedances defined by Geometry. Default values are same as for the default LineCode object: 0.155081 ohms per 1000 ft at 60 Hz for Rho=100 (EPRI Line element page).

properties.name: rho
properties.description: Earth resistivity used to compute earth correction factor. Overrides Line geometry definition if specified. Default=100 meter ohms.

properties.name: geometry
properties.description: Geometry code for LineGeometry Object. Supercedes any previous definition of line impedance. Line constants are computed for each frequency change or rho change. CAUTION: may cause the number of phases to be redefined. Alternative impedance source, used together with length (engine spec set {geometry, length}).

properties.name: earthmodel
properties.description: One of {Carson | FullCarson | Deri}. Default is the global value established with the Set EarthModel option. Used to override the global value for this line. Applies only when the 'geometry' property is used.

properties.name: units
properties.description: Length Units = {none | mi | kft | km | m | Ft | in | cm} Default is None - assumes length units match impedance units.

properties.name: seasons
properties.description: Number of seasonal ampacity ratings. In DSS C-API 0.14.5 the constructor initializes one rating.

properties.name: ratings
properties.description: Seasonal ampacity ratings in amps. The constructor initializes the array with the initial normal ampacity of 400 A. Applying a line code, geometry, or other edits can change a Line's ratings.

properties.name: linetype
properties.description: Line-type code. The engine initializes it as OH. AltDSS-Python exposes LineType as an enum and accepts an enum, integer, or string on assignment.

properties.name: epsrmedium
properties.description: Held for follow-up from the starter catalog. The property is absent from the pinned Line engine definitions and Python wrapper. EPRI release-specific provenance and default remain unverified.

properties.name: like
properties.description: Name of an existing Line object to build this like.

properties.name: spacing
properties.description: Line spacing code (LineSpacing object) for line-constants calculation, used with the 'wires' property: the spacing must be assigned before wires (engine spec set {spacing, wires, length}). Documented in the EPRI Lines interface reference (https://opendss.epri.com/Spacing.html: 'This property sets/gets the line spacing code of the active Line').

properties.name: wires
properties.description: DSS conductor data list used with Spacing. Assign Spacing first. The Python keyword is Conductors, which accepts conductor objects or names for WireData, CNData, and TSData. The DSS engine also has legacy CNCables and TSCables entries sharing conductor storage.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Indicates whether this element is enabled; a disabled element is removed from the circuit solution but not from memory and can be re-enabled. Default: True (engine). Documented in the EPRI element interface reference (https://opendss.epri.com/Enabled.html).

target_versions.opendss_documentation: EPRI online documentation; page version not stated

conditional.when: creating a Line without an explicit length
conditional.requirement: Length initially defaults to 1.0. Later property changes can override it.

conditional.when: creating an explicit complete impedance specification
conditional.notes: These are the full DSS C-API 0.14.5 specification sets. The constructors initialize default sequence data. These sets document complete input combinations for explicit impedance and do not specify the minimum properties the text command or Python constructor accepts. For spacing, assign spacing before wires, called Conductors in AltDSS-Python.

notes: DSS property names are recorded separately from the exact AltDSS-Python creation keywords. The name parameter identifies the new object.
The required_properties list records object identity and model inputs. It does not describe the Python signature or every way to apply properties after creation.
The EPRI pages are undated references. Engine defaults and API details in this revision refer to the pinned stable target.
A null default indicates no fixed documented value in the catalog. See the Phase 2 QA/QC report for the scope of the runtime checks.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Required identifier for the object. Pass it as the name argument to altdss.LineCode.new or after LineCode. in the DSS New command.

properties.name: nphases
properties.description: Number of phases. Default = 3.

properties.name: r1
properties.description: Positive-Sequence resistance, ohms per unit length. Default (default LineCode object): 0.058 ohms per 1000 ft.

properties.name: x1
properties.description: Positive-Sequence reactance, ohms per unit length. Default (default LineCode object): 0.1206 ohms per 1000 ft.

properties.name: r0
properties.description: Zero-Sequence resistance, ohms per unit length. Default (default LineCode object): 0.1784 ohms per 1000 ft.

properties.name: x0
properties.description: Zero-Sequence reactance, ohms per unit length. Default (default LineCode object): 0.4047 ohms per 1000 ft.

properties.name: c1
properties.description: Positive-sequence capacitance in nanofarads per unit length. The default is 3.4 nF per 1,000 ft before unit conversion. The engine stores the constructor value in farads and the public property scales it to nanofarads.

properties.name: c0
properties.description: Zero-sequence capacitance in nanofarads per unit length. The default is 1.6 nF per 1,000 ft before unit conversion. The engine stores the constructor value in farads and the public property scales it to nanofarads.

properties.name: units
properties.description: {mi | km | kft | m | ft | in | cm} Length units. If not specified, it is assumed that the units correspond to the length being used in the Line models. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): none (Units := UNITS_NONE).

properties.name: rmatrix
properties.description: Series resistance matrix, ohms per unit length. The order of matrices expected is the number of phases; matrices may be entered in lower triangle form or full matrix and the result is always symmetrical ('|' separates rows, e.g. Rmatrix="11 | 21 22 | 31 32 33"). If any Symmetrical Component data is specified, the impedance matrices are determined from that data.

properties.name: xmatrix
properties.description: Series reactance matrix, ohms per unit length.

properties.name: cmatrix
properties.description: Shunt nodal capacitance matrix, nanofarads per unit length.

properties.name: basefreq
properties.description: Base frequency in Hz for the impedance values. The EPRI LineCode page lists 60.0 Hz as the default. DSS C-API 0.14.5 initializes this property from the active circuit's fundamental frequency, so the catalog leaves the fixed default unspecified.

properties.name: normamps
properties.description: Normal ampacity, amps. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 400.0.

properties.name: emergamps
properties.description: Emergency ampacity, amps. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 600.0.

properties.name: faultrate
properties.description: Number of faults per year per unit length. This is the default for this general line construction. Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 0.1.

properties.name: pctperm
properties.description: Percent of the fault that become permanent (requiring a line crew to repair and a sustained interruption). Engine default (DSS C-API 0.14.5): 20.0.

properties.name: kron
properties.description: Y/N. Default=N. Perform Kron reduction on the impedance matrix after it is formed, reducing order by 1. Do this only on initial definition after matrices are defined. Ignored for symmetrical components.

properties.name: rg
properties.description: Carson earth return resistance per unit length used to compute impedance values at base frequency. For making better adjustments of line impedance values for frequency for harmonics studies. Default= 0.01805 ohms per 1000 ft at 60 Hz. If you do not wish to adjust the earth return impedance for frequency, set both Rg and Xg to zero.

properties.name: xg
properties.description: Carson earth return reactance per unit length used to compute impedance values at base frequency. For making better adjustments of line impedance values for frequency for harmonics studies. Default= 0.155081 ohms per 1000 ft at 60 Hz. If you do not wish to adjust the earth return impedance for frequency, set both Rg and Xg to zero.

properties.name: rho
properties.description: Earth resistivity used to compute earth correction factor. Default=100 meter ohms.

properties.name: neutral
properties.description: Conductor index removed by Kron reduction. The engine initializes it to NPhases and updates it when the phase count changes. Kron reduction sets it to 0. Set it again before requesting a further reduction.

properties.name: b1
properties.description: Alternate way to specify C1. Micro-siemens per unit length.

properties.name: b0
properties.description: Alternate way to specify C0. Micro-siemens per unit length.

properties.name: seasons
properties.description: Number of seasonal ampacity ratings. In DSS C-API 0.14.5 the constructor initializes one rating.

properties.name: ratings
properties.description: Seasonal ampacity ratings in amps. The LineCode constructor initializes the array with the initial normal ampacity of 400 A.

properties.name: like
properties.description: Name of an existing LineCode object to build this like.

properties.name: repair
properties.description: Hours to repair. The Python property and engine field are present. The 0.14.5 LineCode constructor has no explicit assignment to the field, so the catalog leaves the default unspecified.

properties.name: linetype
properties.description: Line-type code. The engine initializes it as OH. AltDSS-Python exposes LineType as an enum and accepts an enum, integer, or string on assignment.
